# Elided sequence

## Input

- $n \in \mathbb{N}$
- $1, 2, \ldots, n$

## Output

- $n \in \mathbb{N}$
- $1, 2, \ldots, n$

# Indexed elided sequence

## Input

- $n \in \mathbb{N}$
- $c \in \operatorname{Seq}_{n}(\mathbb{R})$
- $c_{1}, \ldots, c_{n}$

## Output

- $n \in \mathbb{N}$
- $c \in \operatorname{Seq}_{n}(\mathbb{R})$
- $c_{1}, \ldots, c_{n}$
